model.architecture: FusionModel (3D ResNet-SE image encoder + tabular MLP)
model.tabular_encoder: TabEnc_A — Linear(n_tab, h) -> BN -> ReLU -> Dropout(0.2) -> Linear(h, 64) -> ReLU
model.fusion_head: Linear(320,128) -> ReLU -> Dropout(0.3) -> Linear(128,64) -> ReLU -> Dropout(0.2) -> Linear(64,1)

step_order: 5. unsqueeze(0) -> tensor shape [1, Z, Y, X]
3. scaler.transform(row)  [StandardScaler fitted on train split only]
